text:
maria-l: sec-bot just fired a spike alert for KMS decrypt errors in prod region eu-west-1, looks noisy though
sec-bot: ALERT  [1954327890] KMS_DECRYPT_FAILURE_RATE > 5% for 5m, affected services: tokenizer, embeddings-svc :rotating_light:
kevin: saw it, digging into logs now. initial hypothesis: scheduled key rotation started 3m ago?
tasha: @kevin confirmed — key-rotation job kicked off at 21:03 UTC across 3 customer KMS aliases. expected but maybe triggering transient errors
jonah: are these actual failed decrypts or retries from SDK backoff? could be client-side retries surfacing as errors
kevin: logs show a mixture — many 400/403 from KMS Proxy but also SDK Retry attempts logged with "AccessDenied" followed by success within 10s in many cases
maria-l: So fuzz vs actual. We should avoid pager noise if it's expected during rotation window. Current rule groups by error count across all tenants -> too broad
ops-sre: suggestion: suppress rule when a rotation flag is present or when event source == "kms-rotation". We have a rotation metadata tag in CloudAudit events: resource.labels.keyRotation=true
jonah: can we detect the rotation window from audit logs reliably? sometimes rotations are staggered and still cause sporadic spikes later
kevin: propose two changes: 1) make rule scoped to persistent failure (error rate sustained >2m after rotation window ends); 2) add a whitelist for known rotation-caused error signatures (AccessDenied followed by Success within 30s)
tasha: +1. Also add dashboard panel showing "KMS transient error ratio" (success-after-retry / total errors) so we can tune threshold instead of disabling alerts
maria-l: example SIEM rule patch (pseudo):
```
rule id: kms_transient_spike_v2
when: count(kms.decrypt.errors) > 50 in 5m
and not exists(kms.audit.resource.labels.keyRotation == true)
or not exists(response_sequence contains "AccessDenied->Success" within 30s)
then: alert(severity=warning)
```
jonah: small nit — SIEM query language uses `has_tag` for audit labels. also prefer severity=info for first hit, escalate to warning if persists 15m
kevin: I'll open a PR to the SIEM rule repo with those changes + unit tests against synthetic rotation events
ops-sre: also: update runbook: mark rotation windows as Maintenance in incident-dashboard so on-call doesn't get paged. add note: if alert resolves within 2m with success-after-retry ratio >0.7 then auto-close
maria-l: people: once kevin PR is up, can you reviewers take a look? @jonah @tasha
kevin: will do in next 20m, labeling "eng-security" and "siem-rules"
tasha: thanks. also recommend adding a Grafana panel to product team dashboard so they stop DMs when they see these blips :grimacing:
maria-l: agreed. folllowups: (1) PR for rule change, (2) new dashboard panel, (3) runbook tweak to treat rotation-tagged events as low urgency. I'll file tickets after PR lands
sec-bot: NOTE: Change detected — KMS rotation job started by infra-automation (id: rot-2026-03-18-21).
kevin: opened PR  https://git.internal/redwood/siem-rules/pull/842  — includes test fixtures and explanation
jonah: reviewing now, will leave comments by EOD
ops-sre: once merged, we should backfill 48h of metrics to validate no missed real incidents during past rotations
maria-l: awesome, thanks everyone. closing thread after PR reviews and tickets created. :thumbsup:
